messages:
dmitri: quick fyi — ran a microbench across Llama-7B, Mixtral-7B, and Qwen-7B with our draft routing patch, seeing a ~18% p99 latency regression when drafts are allowed to pair across families.

eva: hmm that's pretty big. is it constant or spiky?

dmitri: mostly spikey on tails. median fine. p50/90 unchanged. p99 and p999 up.

alice: any kernel fallbacks in the profile?

dmitri: yes — perf trace shows frequent fallback to the "generic attention" kernel for sequences >512 when head_dim != 64. Mixtral heads are 128 in the build we used, so we lose vectorized kernels. snippet: ```trace: runtime_select_kernel attention_generic: count=412 p99=42ms attention_vec4: count=120 p99=9ms```

ben: that explains latency. how does RoPE scaling play in?

dmitri: RoPE scale mismatch triggers different rotary precompute path; we recompile a slower path when scale != 1.0 for Mixtral->Llama combos. precompute cost + extra memcpy kills tails.

carol: KV cache behavior? I remember drafts cause more cache invalidation if tokenizer boundaries differ.

dmitri: exactly — tokenizer mismatch (Qwen BPE vs Llama byte-level) causes more prefix-misaligned cache keys. We see higher KV miss rates: ```kv_hits: 91% -> 74% when mixing families on same session id```

eva: can we mitigate with a routing heuristic: prefer same-family drafts unless acceptance_rate delta > X?

dmitri: propose: 1) same-family preferred by default, 2) acceptance threshold tuning per workload (start X=0.02), 3) warmup prefix caching for cross-family sessions for first 32 tokens to populate cache, 4) head_dim compatibility table to choose kernel at routing time.

alice: head_dim table sounds solid. we should also add a fast-path check in kernel selection: if head_dim mismatch but sequence_len<64 use vec kernel anyway.

ben: do we have perf numbers for those mitigations?
dmitri: quick sim: applying family-preference + warmup prefix cut p99 from 78ms -> 28ms on the stressbench for mixed drafts. acceptance tuning alone reduces erroneous fallbacks by ~60%.

perf-bot: perf/regression:1951234567: p99 latency improved 78->28 ms after branch "draft-routing-fallbacks" on canary cluster.

carol: nice. let's also log tokenizer fingerprint in the routing key so cache keys differ only when tokenizers differ, not by accidental metadata.

eva: agree. add an opt-in flag for private deployments where they might want cross-family routing despite cost.

dmitri: next steps: I'll open a small RFC with the head_dim->kernel map, warmup prefix caching design, and a proposal for acceptance threshold defaults. can we ship a canary to dedicated next week?

alice: yep, I'll help with kernel guard change and a unit test matrix for head dims.

ben: I'll add a micro-eval to measure quality delta vs acceptance threshold so we don't regress output.

carol: ping me when RFC is up, I'll sanity-check KV keyspace changes.

perf-bot: todo: deploy canary draft-routing-fallbacks to dedicated-canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC :rocket:
